jobs.finding: 90/270 pad field is broad and shallow instead of master narrow/deep end projection; other six pads and stock already coherent.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: image edit, narrowly targeted perspective repair. FIRST reference is the exact sheet to edit. SECOND reference is the accepted EMPTY STORAGE PLOT master. Preserve all current physical stock, yaw poses, counts, materials, centered stock contact, lighting, title, labels, panel frame layout and navy background.

Change ONLY TWO pad silhouettes in FIRST: top row third panel RIGHT90° and bottom row third panel LEFT270°. Their current pad fields/borders are incorrectly broad and shallow, like the FRONT view. Replace these two pad fields/perimeters with the visibly NARROWER and DEEPER end-view pad projection in the corresponding SECOND-reference90/270 panels. Copy the master’s outline and dark field, NOT its visible log glyph. At1536×1024 sheet size, target roughly245pixels across and160pixels front-to-back in screen projection for each of these two pads; currently they are about280pixels across and120pixels deep. Thus make the silhouette clearly deeper and narrower, about80% of FRONT0 padwidth and120% of FRONT0 padheight. Exact dimensions are guidance for the perspective change, not new text. Keep each pad centered beneath its UNCHANGED physical stock, allowing natural occlusion of the rear edge. The pad remains nearly zero-thickness dark warm brown with one continuous thin tan outline. Do not raise it, add sidewalls or change the camera framing. The centered painted resource glyph stays fully hidden underneath the stock; do not draw it in a clear region. Do NOT alter the other six panels or the stock in any panel. All diagonal pad orientations are already correct. Only replace the90/270 field and perimeter projection with the master’s narrow/deep rectangle. Keep every label and footer unchanged.
